4.label: Exceeds Standard

3.label: Meets Standard
3.description: Accurately adds and subtracts within 20 and demonstrates solid understanding of tens and ones.

standards.description: Add and subtract within 20, demonstrating fluency for addition and subtraction within 10.

levels.3: Accurately computes within 20 using make-ten or decomposition strategies.
levels.2: Computes with counting on/counting back with occasional errors.
levels.1: Unable to reliably compute within 10 without concrete support.

standards.description: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones.
